name: Mamilla Hotel
positioning: Kosher luxury hotel in Jerusalem designed by Piero Lissoni and Moshe Safdie, a short stroll from Jaffa Gate and the Old City Walls
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Jaffa Gate and the Old City
Guests who need a kosher hotel
Spa-goers who want a hammam and steam rooms

facts.text: The hotel is a short stroll to the Old City Walls, Jaffa Gate and the Mamilla Avenue Mall.
The hotel is close to major sights such as the Tower of David.
The hotel is kosher under the supervision of the Jerusalem Rabbinate.
Happy Fish is a Mediterranean-inspired fish restaurant on a terrace overlooking Mamilla Boulevard.
The Mirror Bar serves cocktails and has an in-house DJ.
Breakfast is served in the Ballroom Dining Room, partly prepared on live cooking stations.
The Espresso Bar is in the hotel lobby.
The Akasha spa's treatment rooms are paired with a private hammam.
Akasha has separate hot steam areas for men and women.
The Akasha studio offers classes including Pilates, spinning, TRX, aerobics and yoga.
The swimming pool area has a dedicated toddler pool.
Mamilla Family Suites have a bathroom and half bath and a living room with sliding panels.

highlights.text: The hotel was designed by Italian Piero Lissoni and Israel-born Moshe Safdie.
Rooms have liquid crystal bathroom walls that turn opaque at the flip of a switch.
The Rooftop Outdoor Lounge & Restaurant offers a view of the Old City.
Each room is assigned a personal host.

considerations.text: Few rooms have views other than into neighboring courtyards or to the streets below.
The lobby wine bar and the Mirror Bar close for Friday evening Sabbath.
The rooftop lounge's Old City views are a warmer-months experience.
